notes: parakeet-redux for LiteRT (litert-community/parakeet-redux): moondream/parakeet-redux (revision 2bf12860, CC-BY-4.0) = nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (FastConformer encoder, 24 layers, TDT decoder, 25 European languages) with a ternary encoder, expanded to float32 and exported with litert-torch 0.9.4 (no NeMo; transformers' ParakeetForTDT layout) into raw LiteRT graphs: an encoder per window bucket (10 / 20 / 30 s; a window runs in the smallest bucket that holds it, with a valid-length mel mask), a log-mel graph per bucket, and one int8 TDT decoder. The encoder's 120 LayerNorm inputs are scaled by 2^-k (eps by 4^-k, k 3-9; bit-identical in fp32) so fp16-storage paths (the HTP, GPU fp16 arithmetic) stay finite. Text = the token ids decoded with the repo's tokenizer.json (the TDT decode: repeated ids kept). Accuracy is WER against reference B_ii (the same windows through transformers' ParakeetForTDT in fp32 with the expanded weights), with both the open-asr-leaderboard formula (L) and jiwer (J). This file: parakeet_redux_mel_10s.tflite (1,608,068 B), the 10 s window bucket; the log-mel front end on the CPU (preemphasis 0.97, STFT n_fft 512 / win 400 / hop 160, Slaney mel 128, log, per-feature normalization over the valid frames). artifact_sha256 = = the work graph mel10.tflite that the runs pushed (the phone's sha256 read-back MATCH) = the Hub LFS sha256 after the upload (SAME). Pixel 8a: the card's CPU form (the card's run-cpu block) on S4; the GPU bucket form does not fit this 8 GB phone (no-go: memory) and its 30 s GPU form ran only beside the unshipped fp32 decoder (not a record). Hub: litert-community/parakeet-redux commit aa008e98cba24f57b5c995b6be95d2e42eb28003 (model sha aa008e98cba24f57b5c995b6be95d2e42eb28003); 15 / 15 SAME.
